blind.description: A stylized medieval or fantasy carboy (demijohn) consisting of a rounded dark green glass bottle encased in a woven golden-brown wicker basket with two side loop handles, sealed at the top with a cylindrical cork stopper. Geometry is solid, clean, and continuous with hand-painted textures, resting flat on its bottom on the ground.
blind.from_above: Concentric circles featuring the small round cork in the center, encircled by the dark green glass neck, surrounded by the woven wicker rim, with two loop handles projecting out to the left and right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.5 ft tall) and roughly 1.2 ft wide across the handles.
